pull_request.title: feat: report each function's cost as a share of network resource limits
pull_request.body:
Closes #131

Adds `cargo-budget-report` as a new workspace member that reports each function's resource cost as a percentage of the corresponding Soroban network resource limit alongside the raw value.

## What changed

- **New `cargo-budget-report` crate**: Reports function resource costs (CPU instructions, read bytes, write bytes) as a share of the network's per-transaction resource limits.
- **Share of Limit column**: Each row in the text table includes the percentage of the network limit the function's cost represents (e.g., 0.01% of the CPU instruction limit).
- **Network-sourced limits**: Fetches limits from the Soroban testnet RPC when available. Falls back to hardcoded Protocol 22 limits with clear documentation when the network is unreachable.
- **Configurable threshold**: `--threshold` flags functions exceeding the share with a ⚠ in the table and a warning summary on stderr.
- **JSON output**: Carries `share_of_limit_pct`, `limits`, `limit_source`, and `threshold_pct` so CI consumers can apply their own thresholds.
- **Readable table**: 6 columns (Package, Function, Metric, Value, Share of Limit, Flag) — adds 2 columns to the original layout.
- **README**: Explains what the percentages mean and where the limits come from.

## Acceptance criteria checklist

- [x] Each metric shows percentage of the network resource limit alongside the raw number
- [x] Limits are sourced from the network, not hardcoded silently; hardcoded limits are versioned against Protocol 22 and documented
- [x] Functions above a configurable share are visually distinguished (\u26a0 flag + stderr warning)
- [x] --json output carries percentages and limits used
- [x] Table stays readable (6 columns, not doubled)
- [x] README.md explains percentage meaning and limit provenance

## CI checks

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` ✅
- `cargo clippy -p cargo-budget-report -- -D warnings` ✅
- `cargo test -p cargo-budget-report` ✅

Note: `cargo-cost-lint` integration tests have a pre-existing `soroban_cost_lints` build failure unrelated to this change.

commits.message:
feat: report each function's cost as a share of network resource limits

Add cargo-budget-report workspace member that displays function resource
costs as a percentage of Soroban's per-transaction network resource limits
(instructions, read bytes, write bytes), alongside the raw values.

Key changes:
- New cargo-budget-report crate with --format text|json output
- Each report row includes share_of_limit_pct (value as % of the network
  limit for that metric)
- Limits are fetched from the Soroban testnet RPC when available; if
  unreachable, hardcoded Protocol 22 limits are used (clearly documented)
- --threshold flag marks functions exceeding the configured share with ⚠
  flag and a warning summary on stderr
- JSON output includes limits, limit_source, threshold_pct, and per-function
  share percentages so consumers can apply their own thresholds
- README.md explains percentage meaning and limit provenance

Closes #131
